auth_refreshToken: Manually refresh the Google OAuth access token for this account before it expires.
calendar_deleteEvent: Delete/cancel an event from a Google Calendar.
calendar_findFreeTime: Find a free meeting time slot shared by multiple people's Google Calendars (scheduling assistant).
calendar_getEvent: Get the full details (time, attendees, location, description) of a specific Google Calendar event.
calendar_list: List all Google Calendars (work, personal, shared) the user has access to.
calendar_listEvents: List events on a Google Calendar within a date range; defaults to upcoming events.
chat_findDmByEmail: Find an existing Google Chat direct-message (DM) conversation with a person by their email address.
chat_findSpaceByName: Find a Google Chat space (group conversation/room) by its display name.
chat_getMessages: Read recent messages from a Google Chat space or DM.
chat_listSpaces: List the Google Chat spaces (rooms/group conversations) the user belongs to.
chat_sendDm: Send a Google Chat direct message to a person by email.
chat_sendMessage: Send a message to a Google Chat space (room).
docs_getSuggestions: List pending suggested edits (tracked changes) in a Google Doc.
docs_getText: Read the plain-text content of a Google Doc.
docs_writeText: Insert or append text into a Google Doc at a given character position.
drive_createFolder: Create a new folder in Google Drive.
drive_findFolder: Find a Google Drive folder by name.
drive_renameFile: Rename a file or folder in Google Drive.
gmail_createDraft: Create a draft email in Gmail without sending it.
gmail_get: Get the full content (headers, body, attachments) of a specific Gmail message.
gmail_listLabels: List all Gmail labels/folders in the mailbox (inbox, sent, custom labels).
gmail_search: Search Gmail for emails/messages using Gmail search operators (from, subject, has:attachment, etc.).
gmail_sendDraft: Send a previously created Gmail draft.
people_getMe: Get the authenticated Google account's own profile (name, email, photo).
people_getUserProfile: Look up another person's Google profile (name, email, photo) by email or resource name.
sheets_getMetadata: Get a Google Sheets spreadsheet's metadata: sheet/tab names, ids, and dimensions (not cell data).
sheets_getRange: Read cell values from a specific range (e.g. a sheet of a budget spreadsheet) in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
sheets_getText: Read all cell/table data from a Google Sheets spreadsheet (e.g. a budget or tracking sheet) as text.
slides_getMetadata: Get a Google Slides presentation's metadata: slide ids, titles, and layout (not slide content).
slides_getText: Read the text content of a Google Slides presentation, including slide body text and speaker notes.
